description: AI image generation from a text prompt. Generate album and single cover art, podcast and video thumbnails, social and campaign graphics, concept art, storyboard frames, product shots, and article illustrations. Returns one hosted still image as PNG or JPEG in square, portrait, or widescreen framing (1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9, 21:9). Async by default: poll the returned pollUrl for imageUrl, or pass ?async=false to block. — $0.15 USDC via x402 on Base (chain 8453).

asyncMode.description: Return immediately with a jobId while the render runs. Can only switch async on: false is the same as omitting it, so a paid call stays asynchronous; ?async=false is the only way to force a blocking call.

name: agent_image
